newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 24.1 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 24.1 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Tuesday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.83 percent and 17.69 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 26.895 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 24.102 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 15,500 million levs 11,394.6 million levs
Bids approved 13,707 million levs 10,394.6 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.83 pct 17.69 pct
